summary: Dwarf rasbora is a miniature reddish freshwater fish marked with dark spots. Malaysian records include peat and acid-water habitats. Genetic research has found substantial differences between regional populations, making protection of several peat-swamp areas important for preserving their diversity.
nativeRange: Peninsular Malaysia and neighbouring parts of Southeast Asia.

features: Dark spots behind the gill cover and near the anal and tail fins
Males are generally more brightly coloured than females

habitat.description: Acid-water and peat-swamp habitats in Peninsular Malaysia.
